title: When Colleges See Senior Grades
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: A timeline of when colleges receive senior-year course and grade information, and how that timing differs for early, regular, and deferred applicants.

learningObjectives: Students will explain when colleges receive senior-year course and grade information and interpret how that timing affects early, regular, and deferred applicants.
prerequisites: Chapter 7: Your Senior Year Course Load

keyQuestions: Why can colleges judge your senior-year rigor before any senior grades exist?
Why does the mid-year report matter more for Regular Decision than for Early Action applicants?
What happens if your final transcript shows a serious drop?
commonMisconceptions: Senior grades don't matter once you've applied.
AP exam scores affect admission decisions.
assessmentOpportunities: Students explain which senior-year grade information a given applicant's college sees before the decision, and what the final transcript confirms.
